body.reason: Of the three, it is the only one whose failure is silent. A total-cost regression appears in a bill; an adaptive-evolution misstep appears as a version mismatch; a fidelity loss appears as a receiver that confidently does the wrong thing and reports success. Your own published result reinforces the ordering: at 0% post-decode saving there is not yet a cost signal to optimise against, and optimising evolution before fidelity is settled moves a target that has not been fixed.
